newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey talks to U.S. consortium on major oilfield.
newsitem.headline: Turkey talks to U.S. consortium on major oilfield.

text.p: The general manager of Turkey's state oil explorer and producer TPAO said on Friday the company was weighing up a proposal from Chevron Corp, Texaco Inc and Atlantic Richfield Co (Arco) to develop an oilfield in the southeastern province of Batman.
"We will present the projects to them and will begin work on them," said Turkiye Petrolleri Anonim Ortakligi (TPAO) general manager Sitki Sancar at a news conference.
He said the province's Batiraman oil field, believed to be the biggest in Turkey, was discovered in 1961.
"There are known to be around two billion barrels of oil in it," he said.

Sancar said production was made difficult because of the heavy oil in the field and said output, currently at around 11,000 barrels per day, could be increased by the introduction of new production methods.
